faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How do I pay for my subscription?
faq.a1: Click "Pay & Upgrade" on any plan to open a KHQR payment modal. You can scan the QR code using ABA Mobile or any Bakong-compatible Cambodian banking app.
faq.q2: What happens if my subscription expires?
faq.a2: Your store, existing products, order history, and customer records remain completely safe. You can renew your subscription at any time to resume adding products and taking new customer orders.
faq.q3: Can I upgrade before my current plan finishes?
faq.a3: Yes! Upgrading immediately expands your product and category capacity, and your new validity days are added smoothly to your existing account.
